Code Mode prompt named tools by registered name instead of the JavaScript name the model must call

System prompt and tool parameter descriptions gave conflicting rules about paths

new_task described in the system prompt in yolo/headless mode where it is not available

SDK renamed Task to Agent; security hooks still matched "Task", so sub-agent controls were silently bypassed in production
Prompt examples used status "pending"; update_plan only allows "planned"
PTC tools rendered without tools. prefix; model confused global task with tools.task (subagent_type vs subagentType)
Large-result and execute guidance pointed to grep and other tools hidden by the tools= allowlist

Hardcoded mode names in the Default prompt drifted from the code's mode metadata
Model instructions implied functions.request_user_input_async exists in every session

All tools presented in the system prompt even in the Minimal profile; model tried tools it did not have

excludeTools with old names did not exclude renamed tools
apply_diff description said one file; the tool supports several
Shell tool description claimed a persistent bash session regardless of the configured shell

Prompt forbade calling "the AgentTool"; the tool is named Agent; also contradicted a sibling section
TOOLS_PROMPT missing 14+ registered tools; loop turns never learned they existed
Fictional tool names (save_artifact, approve_task, mark_complete) in about 13 prompt files after the registry was removed
Execution guidance named terminal, execute_code, read_file on sessions without them; phantom paid calls and a wrong date in records
Tool descriptions named sibling tools by MCP names (search) while the session exposes labkit_search
